headline: Human Rights Committee subcommittee to discuss budget recommendations for human rights education and community events.
summary: The Education and Rapid Response Subcommittee will review its history and purpose, then discuss and recommend a budget to the main HRC body for education objectives, including sharing human rights resources and hosting community events.
items: Status of HRC members and quorum
Subcommittee members to share history and purpose of subcommittee, using public statement template (June/October 2025)

Discuss and make recommendations to the main Beverly HRC body on budgeting for education objectives, including sharing resources to defend human rights and address violations, and hosting community events related to human and civil rights
location: Sohier Room, Beverly Public Library, 32 Essex Street, Beverly, Massachusetts 01915
